Process.Name: proc_BSCS00_OnEntered
Process.Description: **Purpose:** Handles truck arrival at battery swap charge station entry node 00, searching for available station with ready batteries and assigning truck to optimal station. **Search BSCS:** Search tbl_BatterySwapChargeStations table to maximize ready batteries, filtering for available stations **Assign BSCSNode:** Assign selected station node to truck (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.var_BatterySwapChargeStationNode ← tbl_BatterySwapChargeStations.Name.obj_BatterySwapChargeStation.CurrentNode) **Decide ReadyBatteries=0:** Check if search returned zero ready batteries (Token.ReturnValue == 0) **Delay 1min:** Wait 1 minute before retrying station search, then return to step 1 **SetNode BSCSNode:** Route truck to assigned battery swap charge station node

Step.Name: BSCS
Step.Description: **Search BSCS:** Search tbl_BatterySwapChargeStations table to maximize ready batteries, filtering for available stations

Step.Name: ReadyBatteries=0
Step.Description: **Decide ReadyBatteries=0:** Check if search returned zero ready batteries (Token.ReturnValue == 0)

Step.Name: BSCSNode
Step.Description: **Assign BSCSNode:** Assign selected station node to truck (obj_BatteryElectricTruck.var_BatterySwapChargeStationNode ← tbl_BatterySwapChargeStations.Name.obj_BatterySwapChargeStation.CurrentNode)

Step.Name: Delay1
Step.Description: **Delay 1min:** Wait 1 minute before retrying station search, then return to step 1

Step.Name: BSCSNode
Step.Description: **SetNode BSCSNode:** Route truck to assigned battery swap charge station node
